subject: Urgent: WillowPay v5 + qprofile rollout — latency & error surge
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@willowpay.com>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: WillowPay SRE <sre@willowpay.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production rollout — v5 (qprofile=v2q) causing p95 spikes and error rate

Hi Maya,

We started serving Redwood model v5 with the v2q quantization profile this morning on the 09:00 PST rollout and immediately saw a jump in p95 latency from ~420ms to ~1.2s and a concurrent 1.8% 5xx error rate (was ~0.03%). This is across two critical routes (payment-authorize and refund-summarize). Our customers are seeing timeouts.

I attached the metrics dump and a screenshot of the error bursts. SRE captured a couple of decode traces where the worker appears to hang during final token decoding — I've included decode-trace-1129.txt.

Can you confirm if Redwood enabled any new kernel-level flags or changed KV cache behavior with v5 + v2q? We need an immediate mitigation plan (rollback or hotfix) and an ETA. This is impacting live transactions.

Please escalate — CCing our infrastructure lead.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Engineering, WillowPay

Attachments: willowpay_metrics_20261129.csv (csv), decode-trace-1129.txt (text), sre-error-screenshot.png (image)
From: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>

Initial asks:
- Rishi / infra: can you triage the traces and the metrics immediately and confirm whether this is a quantization decode stall or a routing/batching regression?
- Priyom: prepare rollback runbook (pin customers to v4) and checklist for DB/kv-cache invalidation if needed.
- Marissa: I'm going to loop in CS/sales for customer comms and for credit discussions.

Target actions in first 30 minutes: confirm root cause hypothesis and surface quick mitigation (rollback vs kernel patch). I'll keep Elena and their SREs in the loop.

— Maya

Maya / team — noted. From CS side: WillowPay is a strategic mid-market account with high transaction volumes; they are in an active renewal conversation (deal WP-2026-112). We should assume they will ask for short-term credits and require an exec sync if the outage continues >2 hours.

I'm drafting a short note for WP execs and our revenue ops (will share in 10m). For now, prioritize containment. If rollback is feasible <30m, that will be the least risky path for both reliability and customer trust.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Growth & Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production rollout — initial triage (v5 + v2q)

Quick triage notes (from infra):
- Observed behavior: decode stalls cluster during final-token generation; CPU on GPU host spikes intermittently but GPU utilization fluctuates down during stalls. KV cache hit-rate dropped ~12% after rollout.
- Hypothesis: the new quant kernels (v2q) change attention/kernel tiling which increases mem-copies for short sequences; combined with our continuous batching heuristics this can trigger contention and stalls on certain hot-paths (payment-authorize has many short prompts).
- Repro: reproduced locally in a canary with exact qprofile; we see the p95 jump when batch composition includes high proportion of short sequences.

Recommended immediate steps (ordered):
1) Schedule a rolling rollback for WillowPay routes to v4 (pin model on their tenant) — low-risk and reversible.
2) Disable the experimental qprofile v2q for warm starts; revert to v1q for short-sequence routes.
3) Parallel: prepare a hotfix adjusting batching heuristics (reduce cross-request batching for short prompts) and a kernel flag to reduce mem-copy paths.

I can run rollback for their tenant now if we get confirmation. Will collect more traces and open a ticket for kernel teams.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Lead Infra Engineer, Inference Runtime
From: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@willowpay.com>, WillowPay SRE <sre@willowpay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production rollout — rollback plan & timeline

Elena — thanks for your patience. We recommend rolling WillowPay routes back to v4 (current pinned GA model) while we push a hotfix. Rishi verified the reproduce and the rollback is the fastest mitigation.

Proposed plan (15–45 minute window):
- 09:45 PST: start canary rollback for payment-authorize and refund-summarize on 2% traffic. Monitor for p95 and errors (15m).
- 10:05 PST: expand to 25% if stable, then 100% 10:20 PST.
- We'll keep KV cache and session affinity intact to avoid cold-start regressions.

If you approve, we'll schedule the first canary at 09:45 PST. We will provide a post-mortem within 48h and propose a credit for the window as appropriate (Marissa will own credit communication).

Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/playbooks/rollback-v5 — rollback checklist attached in Drive.

— Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference

We expect a short incident summary and an ETA for the full post-mortem and remediation plan. Also please outline next steps to avoid surprise rollout decisions (we were not aware v2q would be turned on for our routes).
